title.narrative: Activity 13: Alumni symposium and capstone training seminar

description.narrative: The Alumni Symposium and Capstone Training Seminar on the Prevention of Identity-Based Violence brought together a network of AIPG cohorts and Focal Point Persons in the Great Lakes Region into a series of focused meetings and training sessions, based on the activities conducted in the past three years. This was the final activity for our Jo Cox memorial grant project with support from the Foreign, Commonwealth, and Development Office (FCDO) through the UK Aid that involved 11 training seminars and 15 online sessions during the 3 years. The symposium attracted delegates from 7 countries in the Great Lakes Region namely, Kenya, Tanzania, Uganda, Burundi, Zambia, the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), and the Central African Republic (CAR) who were joined by representatives from the African Union (AU) and the International Conference on the Great Lakes Region (ICGLR). The participating countries shared lessons learned, reviewed the institutionalization of national prevention mechanisms, adopted strategies to strengthen the African Network for Genocide and Mass Atrocity Prevention and developed a regional plan of action to coordinate and promote IBV prevention as an aspect of genocide and mass atrocity prevention.
